newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait says backing Syria, condemns bus blast.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait says backing Syria, condemns bus blast.

text.p: Kuwait on Sunday condemned the bombing of a bus in central Damascus that killed nine people and wounded 44 and vowed support for the fellow Arab state against any breach to its security.
"The cabinet has observed with extreme concern and sorrow the bombing of a passenger bus in Damascus," said a cabinet statement.

"As the state of Kuwait expresses extreme rejection and condemnation to this criminal act, it asserts...its full solidarity with sisterly Syria in facing all that aims at infringing its security and stability," it said.
"It affirms great confidence in the capability of the political leadership at the sisterly state to confront, firmly and strongly, such criminal acts," it said.
Syria on Thursday accused agents of the Israeli intelligence service Mossad of carrying out the Tuesday bombing. Israel denied the charge.
